compatibility: Result extra scope/continuation metadata is included in canonical descriptor identity, not rejected by a whitelist.
Accepted records are enumerated for view-local index while original_target_index and leg are copied from saved records.
Optional reference must bind this exact result and every accepted state; ancestor HP cannot be supplied for a different extension result.
No native_mean/native_resume/controller import is used by the pure viewer; pinned pure-source origins remain required.
Current actual square geometry and exact reference node (80,30) mm remain mandatory; this is not a general arbitrary-workpiece viewer.
display_limitations: PEAK accepted is argmax(d) within the displayed segment, so a successful 1.15-to-1.10 segment labels 1.15 as segment peak; it does not recover the original 1.20 full-task peak.
production_path_completed copies result.path_completed and describes the child segment only; full original/extended path qualification must remain separately false.
New saved geometry/nodal observations and media remain future separately authorized work; source compatibility does not prove a future view PASS.
